name: Majestic Hotel & Spa Barcelona
positioning: A hotel over 100 years old on Passeig de Gràcia in Barcelona, a block from Gaudí's La Pedrera, with a rooftop restaurant and bar and a spa on the top floor
best_for: Travelers who want a Passeig de Gràcia base a block from La Pedrera
Food lovers interested in a restaurant supplied by the hotel's own farm
Families who want family rooms or apartments

facts.text: The hotel is at Paseo de Gracia 68-70, 08007 Barcelona.
The hotel is a block away from Gaudí's La Pedrera (Casa Milà).
The Majestic is over 100 years old.
Fish for Restaurant SOLC comes daily from the Barcelona fish market.
SOLC serves a gourmet brunch every Sunday.
Chef David Romero devised the SOLC Gourmet Brunch, which follows SOLC's farm-to-table concept.
A pianist plays in El Bar del Majestic several evenings a week.
The wellness area has a heated pool and a hydromassage pool.
The spa is on the highest floor of the building.
The Penthouse Suite has a private terrace with a solarium and panoramic views over Paseo de Gracia or the Sagrada Familia.
Privilege Family rooms sleep up to 3 adults or 2 adults and 2 children under 12, with a king bed and a sofa bed.
A Rossano Ferretti HairSpa had its grand opening at the hotel on 9 October 2026.

highlights.text: The hotel has its own farm in the Maresme area, near the Mediterranean, which grows vegetables for Restaurant SOLC.
La Dolce Vitae is a restaurant and bar on the hotel's rooftop terrace, with views of the Sagrada Familia, Casa Batlló and the Glòries Tower.
Bathroom products are by Atelier Cologne, which also created the hotel's own scent, Musc Impérial.
The Royal Penthouse includes a driver, luxury car, private butler and a private rooftop terrace with an outdoor jacuzzi.
On summer nights the rooftop hosts the Majestic Sunset Sessions with a resident DJ and international guest DJs.

considerations.text: The hotel's apartments are at 69 Passeig de Gràcia, across from the hotel in a separate building.
WhataHotel notes the busy street location may bring some urban noise.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
